title: ACE Content Work Item (CWI)
description: Canonical contract for the CWI record created by POST /api/content-work-item. product_id is nullable in the base schema; the if/then branch narrows it to a non-null, non-empty string for PRODUCT and REVIEW work items. Canonical source of truth for this contract; HANDOFF.md section 4 quotes the decisive fragments only.

type.description: Work-item kind. PRODUCT and REVIEW are product-bound: the if/then branch requires a non-null product_id for them. METHOD and WORKFLOW are not product-bound: they inherit the nullable product_id base, so product_id may be absent or null. Further non-product kinds may be added to this enum later; they inherit the same nullable base and are not constrained by the if/then branch.

product_id.description: Identifier of the product this work item is about. Base schema: a string or null. For type PRODUCT or REVIEW the if/then branch narrows this to a non-null string with minLength 1.

decision.description: Current lifecycle value. The server defaults to PENDING. The decision vocabulary is not yet fixed by the spec, so it is deliberately unconstrained here; narrow it only once the team agrees the closed set (open question in HANDOFF.md section 7).
